items: Vice President Sara Duterte has links to Jollibee through her ownership stake in Gencorp Industries, which operates at least five Jollibee branches in Davao City.

During her impeachment trial, receipts were presented showing Gencorp's ownership of these branches, raising concerns about potential conflicts of interest due to contracts with the Davao City government.

We know by now that Vice President Sara Duterte has some links to Jollibee because the company she declared in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) has franchises of the fast-food giant.
But just how many branches does Gencorp Industries Inc. (Gencorp) operate?
During the impeachment trial on Friday, October 9, the prosecution presented receipts from Jollibee branches in Davao City showing Gencorp as the owner.

blocks.caption: RISIBO. A composite of five receipts of Jollibee branches in Davao City owned by Gencorp Industries where Vice President Sara Duterte is a stockholder. These receipts were presented by the prosecution in the impeachment trial on October 9, 2026.

Jollibee Bolton is a known hangout spot of the Dutertes.

blocks.caption: FAST FOOD. Former president Rodrigo Duterte (right) and Senator Bong Go (left) eat in Jollibee Bolton Street in Davao City on June 28, 2022, after Duterte’s son Baste took his oath as Davao City mayor. Photo by Bong Go/Facebook

blocks.text: Rappler first reported that Gencorp cornered millions of pesos in contracts with the Davao City government in 2022, coinciding with the time that Sara became the Vice President, and her brother Sebastian assumed the mayorship of their hometown. The arrangement raises questions on conflict of interest, and potential violation of the Constitution.
While Duterte herself declared that she is a stockholder of Gencorp in her SALN, the absence of her name in the company’s Securities and Exchange Commission documents has been a head-scratcher.

blocks.caption: Bida ang saya: Is your fave Jollibee spot owned by Sara Duterte?

blocks.text: “The reason why I think VP Sara included Gencorp in her SALN is because its value is huge,” prosecution witness, financial forensic analyst Alexander Cabrera, theorized on Friday.

He explained that an investor would need between P35 million to P50 million for a Jollibee franchise with P35 million being a “very conservative [figure]…because you need working capital pambayad sa crew, pambayad sa manager, pambayad sa rent, initial inventory (to pay for the crew, the manager, rent, initial inventory).”

Cabrera, who reviewed voluminous financial records of Duterte, said upon comparison of Gencorp’s bank inflows and financial statements, it was concluded that the firm has P1.1 billion in undeclared wealth.

blocks.caption: Jollibee enters the menu as impeach court scrutinizes Sara Duterte businesses

blocks.text: Cabrera said that overall, Duterte has P817 million in undeclared wealth from 2022 to 2025, including P212.6 million from undeclared income from Gencorp.
How did the analyst compute that figure when Duterte’s stake at Gencorp hasn’t been disclosed in corporate filings?
“We applied a conservative 20% percentage,” Cabrera said. – Rappler.com
